standards.notes: Type icon SVG carries aria-hidden=true. Close button carries aria-label. All non-text content has a text alternative.
Title color --notification-toast-title-color (#1F2A37) and helper color --notification-toast-helper-color (#384250) on white background. Contrast verification pending audit tool run.
Icon container background color changes per type. Contrast of icon against background pending audit.
All interactive elements (close button, action buttons) are native <button> elements. Keyboard operability delegated to button contract.
Focus styles on close and action buttons handled by button component CSS. No focus suppression in notification-toast CSS.
Root carries role=alert or role=status. Close button has aria-label. Action buttons have .btn__text.
role=alert (assertive) used for critical-error and warning types. role=status (polite) recommended for neutral, info, success types. Consumer is responsible for correct role selection per type.
All visual values use component-level --notification-toast-* tokens. No hardcoded hex/px values in component selectors. --notification-toast-shadow missing from token.css — tracked as TODO.
All directional CSS uses logical properties: padding-inline, inset-inline-end. RTL mirrors automatically via dir attribute.
Component contract documents role=alert / role=status usage guidance per type.
Font family token --notification-toast-font-family maps to IBM Plex Sans Arabic via --Font-Family-font-family-text.
